earlier_sources: None known: google/fonts has no source block for this family; the fonts were added as built in google/fonts#1459 (2018, "korean families r01"), and FONTRIX publishes no source repository.
disclose: The released font is hinted (TrueType instructions). These sources carry no TrueType instructions, so the build is hinted by ttfautohint: the outlines, spacing and layout are the release's, its rendering at small sizes under a TrueType interpreter is not. Hinting is not compared by the gates.
